scripts.title: this script tp you to the end
scripts.features:
[+] Instant Win Warp – Warps your character directly to the final win zone coordinates with a single click.

[+] Auto Win Farm – Automates the winning process by repeatedly teleporting you to the end zone for effortless point accumulation.

[+] Precision TP Delay – Features a specialized slider to adjust the teleport frequency (down to 0.5s increments) for maximum efficiency.

[+] Custom WalkSpeed – Grants full control over your character's movement velocity, allowing for speeds up to 500.

[+] Anti-AFK System – Ensures your session remains active indefinitely by bypassing the server's idle-kick timer.

[+] Coordinate Notification – Provides real-time visual confirmation and feedback whenever a teleport is successfully executed.
